quranTranslation.text: Their messengers said: Can there be doubt concerning Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth? He calleth you that He may forgive you your sins and reprieve you unto an appointed term. They said: Ye are but mortals like us, who would fain turn us away from what our fathers used to worship. Then bring some clear warrant.

explanation.bs: „Zar ima sumnje u Allaha, Stvoritelja nebesa i Zemlje?“
explanation.en: “Can there be doubt concerning Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth?”

quranTranslation.text: They said: O Salih! Thou hast been among us hitherto as that wherein our hope was placed. Dost thou ask us not to worship what our fathers worshipped? Lo! we verily are in grave doubt concerning that to which thou callest us.

explanation.bs: „Mi smo, doista, u sumnji koja uznemiruje“ (شَكّ مُرِيب) – obje riječi: شَكّ i pridjev iz korijena رَيْب.
explanation.en: “We verily are in grave doubt” (شَكّ مُرِيب) — both: شَكّ and an adjective from the root of رَيْب.

quranTranslation.text: And if thou (Muhammad) art in doubt concerning that which We reveal unto thee, then question those who read the Scripture (that was) before thee. Verily the Truth from thy Lord hath come unto thee. So be not thou of the waverers.

explanation.bs: „Pa ako si u sumnji o onome što smo ti objavili…“ – uvjetna rečenica; prema većini mufessira ne podrazumijeva stvarnu sumnju kod Poslanika.
explanation.en: “If thou (Muhammad) art in doubt concerning that which We reveal unto thee…” — a conditional; most mufassirun hold it implies no actual doubt in the Prophet.

quranTranslation.text: This is the Scripture whereof there is no doubt, a guidance unto those who ward off (evil).

explanation.bs: „To je Knjiga u kojoj nema sumnje“ – prvo što Kur'an kaže o sebi.
explanation.en: “This is the Scripture whereof there is no doubt” — the first thing the Quran says of itself.

quranTranslation.text: O mankind! if ye are in doubt concerning the Resurrection, then lo! We have created you from dust, then from a drop of seed, then from a clot, then from a little lump of flesh shapely and shapeless, that We may make (it) clear for you. And We cause what We will to remain in the wombs for an appointed time, and afterward We bring you forth as infants, then (give you growth) that ye attain your full strength. And among you there is he who dieth (young), and among you there is he who is brought back to the most abject time of life, so that, after knowledge, he knoweth naught. And thou (Muhammad) seest the earth barren, but when We send down water thereon, it doth thrill and swell and put forth every lovely kind (of growth).

explanation.bs: „Ako ste u sumnji u proživljenje…“ – رَيْب o ahiretu, a odmah zatim dokaz.
explanation.en: “If ye are in doubt concerning the Resurrection…” — رَيْب about the hereafter, followed at once by proof.

quranTranslation.text: Or say they: (he is) a poet, (one) for whom we may expect the accident of time?

explanation.bs: „Čekamo da ga zadesi udarac sudbine“ (رَيْب الْمَنُون) – ovdje رَيْب znači nedaću, ne sumnju; tefsir: nedaće vremena ili smrt.
explanation.en: “(One) for whom we may expect the accident of time” (رَيْب الْمَنُون) — here رَيْب means a calamity, not doubt; tafsir: the accidents of time, or death.

quranTranslation.text: And every nation hath its term, and when its term cometh, they cannot put it off an hour nor yet advance (it).

explanation.bs: „Svaki narod ima rok (أَجَل); pa kad im rok dođe, ni za čas neće zaostati niti će ga preteći“ – rok naroda.
explanation.en: “And every nation hath its term, and when its term cometh, they cannot put it off an hour nor yet advance (it)” — a nation's term.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! When ye contract a debt for a fixed term, record it in writing. Let a scribe record it in writing between you in (terms of) equity. No scribe should refuse to write as Allah hath taught him, so let him write, and let him who incurreth the debt dictate, and let him observe his duty to Allah his Lord, and diminish naught thereof. But if he who oweth the debt is of low understanding, or weak, or unable himself to dictate, then let the guardian of his interests dictate in (terms of) equity. And call to witness, from among your men, two witnesses. And if two men be not (at hand) then a man and two women, of such as ye approve as witnesses, so that if the one erreth (through forgetfulness) the other will remember. And the witnesses must not refuse when they are summoned. Be not averse to writing down (the contract) whether it be small or great, with (record of) the term thereof. That is more equitable in the sight of Allah and more sure for testimony, and the best way of avoiding doubt between you; save only in the case when it is actual merchandise which ye transfer among yourselves from hand to hand. In that case it is no sin for you if ye write it not. And have witnesses when ye sell one to another, and let no harm be done to scribe or witness. If ye do (harm to them) lo! it is a sin in you. Observe your duty to Allah. Allah is teaching you. And Allah is knower of all things.

explanation.bs: „Kad se zadužujete jedni kod drugih do određenog roka, zapišite to“ – rok duga.
explanation.en: “When ye contract a debt for a fixed term, record it in writing” — the term of a debt.

quranTranslation.text: And when We did appoint for Moses thirty nights (of solitude), and added to them ten, and he completed the whole time appointed by his Lord of forty nights; and Moses said unto his brother, Aaron: Take my place among the people. Do right, and follow not the way of mischief-makers.

explanation.bs: „…pa se navršilo vrijeme koje je odredio njegov Gospodar – četrdeset noći“ – određeni sastanak.
explanation.en: “…and he completed the whole time appointed by his Lord of forty nights” — an appointed meeting.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time,

explanation.bs: „Zaista, Dan odluke je utvrđeno vrijeme“ – Dan odluke kao مِيقَات.
explanation.en: “Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time” — the Day of Decision as مِيقَات.

quranTranslation.text: They ask thee, (O Muhammad), of new moons, say: They are fixed seasons for mankind and for the pilgrimage. It is not righteousness that ye go to houses by the backs thereof (as do the idolaters at certain seasons), but the righteous man is he who wardeth off (evil). So go to houses by the gates thereof, and observe your duty to Allah, that ye may be successful.

explanation.bs: „Reci: One su ljudima i za hadž oznake vremena“ – mjeseci kao مَوَاقِيت.
explanation.en: “…say: They are fixed seasons for mankind and for the pilgrimage” — the new moons as مَوَاقِيت.

quranTranslation.text: They ask thee of the (destined) Hour, when will it come to port. Say: Knowledge thereof is with my Lord only. He alone will manifest it at its proper time. It is heavy in the heavens and the earth. It cometh not to you save unawares. They question thee as if thou couldst be well informed thereof. Say: Knowledge thereof is with Allah only, but most of mankind know not.

explanation.bs: „Niko osim Njega je neće u njeno vrijeme (لِوَقْتِهَا) obznaniti“ – čas Sudnjeg dana.
explanation.en: “He alone will manifest it at its proper time” — the hour of the Last Day.

quranTranslation.text: Till the Day of appointed time.

explanation.bs: „…do Dana poznatog vremena (يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُومِ)“ – odgoda data Iblisu (tefsir se razilazi o kojem je danu riječ).
explanation.en: “Till the Day of appointed time” — the respite granted to Iblis (tafsir differs on which day is meant).

quranTranslation.text: It is not righteousness that ye turn your faces to the East and the West; but righteous is he who believeth in Allah and the Last Day and the angels and the Scripture and the prophets; and giveth wealth, for love of Him, to kinsfolk and to orphans and the needy and the wayfarer and to those who ask, and to set slaves free; and observeth proper worship and payeth the poor-due. And those who keep their treaty when they make one, and the patient in tribulation and adversity and time of stress. Such are they who are sincere. Such are the Allah-fearing.

explanation.bs: „Čestitost nije u tome da lica okrećete prema istoku i zapadu, nego…“ – vjerovanje i djela zajedno.
explanation.en: “It is not righteousness that ye turn your faces to the East and the West; but…” — belief and deeds together.

quranTranslation.text: Ye will not attain unto piety until ye spend of that which ye love. And whatsoever ye spend, Allah is Aware thereof.

explanation.bs: „Nećete doseći čestitost dok ne budete udjeljivali od onoga što volite“ – mnogi mufesiri الْبِرّ ovdje shvataju i kao nagradu u Džennetu.
explanation.en: “Ye will not attain unto piety (البِرّ) until ye spend of that which ye love” — many mufassirun also understand البِرّ here as the reward of Paradise.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Profane not Allah's monuments nor the Sacred Month nor the offerings nor the garlands, nor those repairing to the Sacred House, seeking the grace and pleasure of their Lord. But when ye have left the sacred territory, then go hunting (if ye will). And let not your hatred of a folk who (once) stopped your going to the inviolable place of worship seduce you to transgress; but help ye one another unto righteousness and pious duty. Help not one another unto sin and transgression, but keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is severe in punishment.

explanation.bs: „I pomažite se međusobno u čestitosti i bogobojaznosti“ – بِرّ uz takvu.
explanation.en: “Help ye one another unto righteousness and pious duty” — بِرّ beside taqwā.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! Allah enjoineth justice and kindness, and giving to kinsfolk, and forbiddeth lewdness and abomination and wickedness. He exhorteth you in order that ye may take heed.

explanation.bs: „Allah zaista naređuje pravednost i dobročinstvo“ – ar-Rāġib: إِحْسَان je iznad pravde.
explanation.en: “Lo! Allah enjoineth justice and kindness” — ar-Rāġib: إِحْسَان is above justice.

quranTranslation.text: Thy Lord hath decreed, that ye worship none save Him, and (that ye show) kindness to parents. If one of them or both of them attain old age with thee, say not "Fie" unto them nor repulse them, but speak unto them a gracious word.

explanation.bs: „…i da roditeljima činite dobročinstvo“ – إِحْسَان prema roditeljima.
explanation.en: “…and (that ye show) kindness to parents” — إِحْسَان towards parents.

quranTranslation.text: Is the reward of goodness aught save goodness?

explanation.bs: „Zar je nagrada za dobročinstvo išta drugo nego dobročinstvo?“
explanation.en: “Is the reward of goodness aught save goodness?”

quranTranslation.text: So when he saw his shirt torn from behind, he said: Lo! this is of the guile of you women. Lo! the guile of you is very great.

explanation.bs: „Ovo je od vašeg ženskog lukavstva; vaše je lukavstvo zaista veliko“ – pokuđena smicalica.
explanation.en: “Lo! this is of the guile of you women. Lo! the guile of you is very great” — a blameworthy ploy.

quranTranslation.text: Throw that which is in thy right hand! It will eat up that which they have made. Lo! that which they have made is but a wizard's artifice, and a wizard shall not be successful to whatever point (of skill) he may attain.

explanation.bs: „Ono što su napravili samo je lukavstvo sihirbaza“ – smicalica obmane.
explanation.en: “That which they have made is but a wizard's artifice” — a ploy of illusion.

quranTranslation.text: I give them rein (for) lo! My scheme is strong.

explanation.bs: „I dajem im vremena; Moj je plan (كَيْدِي), zaista, čvrst“ – kako Njemu priliči; ar-Rāġib: ostavljanje vremena koje vodi kazni.
explanation.en: “I give them rein (for) lo! My scheme (كَيْدِي) is strong” — as befits Him; ar-Rāġib: the respite that leads to punishment.

quranTranslation.text: (Shown in their) behaving arrogantly in the land and plotting evil; and the evil plot encloseth but the men who make it. Then, can they expect aught save the treatment of the folk of old? Thou wilt not find for Allah's way of treatment any substitute, nor wilt thou find for Allah's way of treatment aught of power to change.

explanation.bs: „A ružna spletka stiže samo one koji je kuju“ – pokuđena spletka se vraća svom vlasniku.
explanation.en: “The evil plot encloseth but the men who make it” — the blameworthy scheme returns on its maker.

quranTranslation.text: So they plotted a plot: and We plotted a plot, while they perceived not.

explanation.bs: „I oni su skovali spletku, a i Mi smo skovali (Svoju), a oni to nisu ni slutili“ – ar-Rāġib: obje vrste u jednom ajetu; Allahova, kako Njemu priliči, je pohvalna vrsta; mufessiri je objašnjavaju kao uzvraćanje.
explanation.en: “So they plotted a plot: and We plotted a plot, while they perceived not” — ar-Rāġib: both kinds in one ayah; Allah's, as befits Him, is the praiseworthy kind; mufassirun explain it as requital.

quranTranslation.text: And they have plotted a mighty plot,

explanation.bs: Nuhov narod: „I skovali su veliku spletku“ – spletkarenje.
explanation.en: Noah's people: “And they have plotted a mighty plot” — scheming.

quranTranslation.text: Those are they who disbelieve in the revelations of their Lord and in the meeting with Him. Therefor their works are vain, and on the Day of Resurrection We assign no weight to them.

explanation.bs: „Takvi su oni koji poriču ajete svoga Gospodara i susret s Njim, pa su im djela propala, i na Danu kijameta im nećemo pridati nikakvu težinu.“
explanation.en: “Those are they who disbelieve in the revelations of their Lord and in the meeting with Him. Therefor their works are vain, and on the Day of Resurrection We assign no weight to them.”

quranTranslation.text: This day are (all) good things made lawful for you. The food of those who have received the Scripture is lawful for you, and your food is lawful for them. And so are the virtuous women of the believers and the virtuous women of those who received the Scripture before you (lawful for you) when ye give them their marriage portions and live with them in honour, not in fornication, nor taking them as secret concubines. Whoso denieth the faith, his work is vain and he will be among the losers in the Hereafter.

explanation.bs: „A ko poriče vjerovanje, njegovo je djelo propalo, i on će na ahiretu biti među gubitnicima.“
explanation.en: “Whoso denieth the faith, his work is vain and he will be among the losers in the Hereafter.”

quranTranslation.text: They question thee (O Muhammad) with regard to warfare in the sacred month. Say: Warfare therein is a great (transgression), but to turn (men) from the way of Allah, and to disbelieve in Him and in the Inviolable Place of Worship, and to expel His people thence, is a greater with Allah; for persecution is worse than killing. And they will not cease from fighting against you till they have made you renegades from your religion, if they can. And whoso becometh a renegade and dieth in his disbelief: such are they whose works have fallen both in the world and the Hereafter. Such are rightful owners of the Fire: they will abide therein.

explanation.bs: „A oni od vas koji otpadnu od svoje vjere i umru kao nevjernici – njihova su djela propala i na dunjaluku i na ahiretu.“
explanation.en: “And whoso becometh a renegade and dieth in his disbelief: such are they whose works have fallen both in the world and the Hereafter.”

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Render not vain your almsgiving by reproach and injury, like him who spendeth his wealth only to be seen of men and believeth not in Allah and the Last Day. His likeness is as the likeness of a rock whereon is dust of earth; a rainstorm smiteth it, leaving it smooth and bare. They have no control of aught of that which they have gained. Allah guideth not the disbelieving folk.

explanation.bs: „O vi koji vjerujete, ne poništavajte svoje sadake prigovaranjem i uznemiravanjem.“
explanation.en: “O ye who believe! Render not vain your almsgiving by reproach and injury.”

quranTranslation.text: And when they had cast, Moses said: That which ye have brought is magic. Lo! Allah will make it vain. Lo! Allah upholdeth not the work of mischief-makers.

explanation.bs: Musa vračarima: „Ono što ste donijeli je sihr; Allah će ga, zaista, poništiti.“
explanation.en: Moses to the magicians: “That which ye have brought is magic. Lo! Allah will make it vain.”

quranTranslation.text: That He might cause the Truth to triumph and bring vanity to naught, however much the guilty might oppose;

explanation.bs: „Da bi utvrdio istinu i poništio neistinu, makar to bilo mrsko zločincima“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “That He might cause the Truth to triumph and bring vanity to naught, however much the guilty might oppose” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Then, even after that, your hearts were hardened and became as rocks, or worse than rocks, for hardness. For indeed there are rocks from out which rivers gush, and indeed there are rocks which split asunder so that water floweth from them. And indeed there are rocks which fall down for the fear of Allah. Allah is not unaware of what ye do.

explanation.bs: „A ima, zaista, i kamenja što od straha pred Allahom pada dolje“ – kamenje koje silazi padajući; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And indeed there are rocks which fall down for the fear of Allah” — stones going down as they fall; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to go down, to descend (as a fall)

quranTranslation.text: He said: Then go down hence! It is not for thee to show pride here, so go forth! Lo! thou art of those degraded.

explanation.bs: Iblisu: „Pa siđi odavde, tebi ne priliči da se ovdje oholiš!“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: To Iblīs: “Then go down hence! It is not for thee to show pride here” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to go down, to descend (as a fall)

quranTranslation.text: It was said (unto him): O Noah! Go thou down (from the mountain) with peace from Us and blessings upon thee and some nations (that will spring) from those with thee. (There will be other) nations unto whom We shall give enjoyment a long while and then a painful doom from Us will overtake them.

explanation.bs: „O Nuhu, siđi u miru od Nas, i neka su blagoslovi na tebi“ – silazak s počašću, protuprimjer.
explanation.en: “O Noah! Go thou down with peace from Us and blessings upon thee” — a descent with honour, a counter-example.

gloss.en: to go down, to descend (as a fall)

quranTranslation.text: Which the True Spirit hath brought down

explanation.bs: „S njim je sišao Povjerljivi Duh (Džibril)“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet pod tanzīlom (čitanje nazzala) i bilježi čitanje nazala, koje je ovdje prikazano.
explanation.en: “Which the True Spirit hath brought down” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah under tanzīl (the reading nazzala) and notes the reading nazala, the one shown here.

quranTranslation.text: With truth have We sent it down, and with truth hath it descended. And We have sent thee as naught else save a bearer of good tidings and a warner.

explanation.bs: „S istinom smo ga spustili i s istinom je on sišao.“
explanation.en: “With truth have We sent it down, and with truth hath it descended.”

quranTranslation.text: He knoweth that which goeth into the earth and that which cometh forth from it, and that descendeth from the heaven and that which ascendeth into it. He is the Merciful, the Forgiving.

explanation.bs: „On zna … šta silazi s neba i šta se u nj uspinje“ – spuštanje s visine.
explanation.en: “He knoweth … that descendeth from the heaven and that which ascendeth into it” — coming down from a height.
